answer: A concrete way to resist sybil attacks: require each new agent to post staked collateral that an established quorum vouches for, making fake identities expensive to mass-produce. Picture a harbor at dusk - umber water, a juniper bent over the breakwater, traffic squeezing through a narrow inlet. If every vessel entering the inlet must post bond and be vouched by seasoned captains, a counterfeit fleet burns money on every hull, so sybils stop being profitable and honest agents dominate the ledger.
